Common Mistakes Homeowners Make with Lawn Care

Many homeowners in Chicago inadvertently make mistakes that hinder their lawn's health and appearance, often leading to more costly interventions later. These include improper mowing height (cutting too short can stress grass), inconsistent watering schedules, and neglecting crucial weed and pest control. Failing to address seasonal needs, like proper leaf removal or winterization, can also significantly impact lawn vitality. Opting for professional expertise from UNO PRO SERVICES helps avoid these pitfalls, leveraging our knowledge of local conditions and best practices to cultivate a resilient and beautiful lawn.
